invariants: Preserve both live quest ids, all objective ids, objective tasks, graph edges, battle opponents, scaling, coordinates, profession-specific reward chests, AI stats, jutsu mechanics, and AI profile rule logic unless explicitly changed below.
Drowned Fleet is out of scope.
Player-facing prose must contain no em dash or en dash.
Generic/shared jutsu keep their current names and records.
Top-level quest sceneBackground must be set deliberately during implementation rather than preserving the current empty string.

6Ri-W5TtUrEMWpyYlnf_F.name: Ghost Ship (Gather)
6Ri-W5TtUrEMWpyYlnf_F.description: The legendary Ghost Ship has appeared again, held aloft by a failing network of chakra seals. Board it before it vanishes, brave the crew it remembers, and escape with whatever the lost warship still guards.
6Ri-W5TtUrEMWpyYlnf_F.successDescription: The Ghost Ship slips back into legend, leaving only the spoils you carried away.

HckXVOf-qk6ESU9t5rxLh.name: Ghost Ship (Hunt)
HckXVOf-qk6ESU9t5rxLh.description: The legendary Ghost Ship has appeared again, held aloft by a failing network of chakra seals. Board it before it vanishes, brave the crew it remembers, and escape with whatever the lost warship still guards.
HckXVOf-qk6ESU9t5rxLh.successDescription: The Ghost Ship slips back into legend, leaving only the spoils you carried away.

d_intro.description: The Ghost Ship crosses the moon without touching the sea. Pale seal-light pulses beneath its keel, and the air bends around a hull that vanished decades ago. Tonight it hangs low enough to board. Choose your way in.

d_gang.description: The Deck Warden waits at the top of the gangplank beside two unstable seal charges. His outline flickers with pale script, then hardens into something solid enough to fight.

b_gang.description: Break the Deck Warden and the unstable charges guarding the entry.

r_gang.description: The Deck Warden drives you back over the rail. The ship does not pursue. Board again.

c_climb.description: Climb the anchor chain beneath the hull, following the pulse of seal-light toward a maintenance breach.

d_bilgein.description: Inside the lower hull, broken seal-lines leak pale chakra into soaked timber and hanging cable. The mess folds inward and stands up. The Core Horror has mistaken wreckage for a body.

b_bilge.description: The Core Horror tears itself free of the lower hull.

r_bilge.description: The Horror collapses over you in timber, cable, and cold chakra. When the ship rebuilds the breach, you are back outside it. Climb again.

d_parley.description: An Oathkeeper appears at the rail, pale script running across his coat and hands. He raises one palm. 'Answer true and walk aboard oathbound. Answer false and prove yourself by force. What does every traveler keep while every journey spends it?'

d_oathpass.description: 'True.' The Oathkeeper steps aside. Seal-lines brighten beneath your feet as the crew parts toward the helm. 'Oath accepted. The Captain will know.'

d_duel.description: 'False.' The Oathkeeper draws a narrow blade and salutes. 'Then let skill answer.'

b_herald.description: The Oathkeeper lowers his blade and begins the test.

r_parley.description: The Oathkeeper's blade finds you three times. He lowers it, unimpressed, and the ship's seals cast you back outside. Call again.

d_deck.description: The deck stretches wider than the hull should allow. Seal-script crawls through the planks beneath dark sails while three routes open ahead: the chart room, the sealed hold, or the long walk to the helm.

d_quarters.description: The Wayfinder looks up from charts that cannot all describe the same world. Coastlines, mountains, and villages overlap in impossible positions. A coded route sheet hangs from his belt.

b_nav.description: The Wayfinder redraws the room around you.

r_quarters.description: Ink, seal-light, and false horizons swallow the room. When your sight returns, you are back on the deck. The chart room waits.

d_map.description: You tear the coded route sheet free. Familiar landmarks are marked from impossible angles, but one hidden supply cache is clear enough to follow.

d_hold.description: Rows of sealed crates rise through the hold, each marked with old shinobi logistics codes. The Arsenal Keeper steps between you and the stores, a counterweight maul resting on one shoulder. 'Nothing leaves unaccounted.'

b_qm.description: The Arsenal Keeper raises the counterweight maul.

r_hold.description: The maul ends the argument. The ship's seals cast you back to the deck while the hold closes behind him. Descend again.

d_helm.description: Two Deck Wardens hold the approach to the helm. Beyond them, the command dais glows around a fractured ring of white crystal.

b_helm.description: The Wardens bar the last steps to the helm.

r_helm.description: The Wardens hold the passage and the command dais remains beyond them. Try again.

d_helm_oath.description: Even the oathbound are tested before the helm. Two Deck Wardens step into the passage as the seal-lines beneath them flare white.

b_helm_oath.description: The Wardens bar the way, oath or no oath.

r_helm_oath.description: The Wardens hold. The oath remains recorded. Try the passage again.

d_riddle.description: A notation along the route sheet reads: 'Where the cliff drinks and the stone keeps watch, the cache sleeps beneath the watcher's shadow.' Three coves match part of the description.
choices: The cove beneath the stone shrine
The cove with the split cliff
The open beach past the reef

d_wrong1.description: You dig until the tide reaches your knees. Broken seal plates and driftwood, nothing more. The watcher's shadow falls elsewhere.

d_wrong2.description: Only reef stone and an old anchor frame lie beneath the sand. Re-read the route sheet.

c_dig.description: Dig beneath the stone watcher's shadow before the tide shifts.

d_guardian.description: Your shovel strikes metal. Sand bursts outward as the Sentinel unfolds from a buried seal frame, armor plated with shell and stone around the cache.

b_guardian.description: The Sentinel rises between you and the cache.

r_dig.description: The Sentinel drives you into the sand and settles back over the buried seal frame. The cache remains.

d_claim_A.description: The Sentinel breaks apart into sand and fading script. Beneath it sits a sealed field cache, intact after decades.

w_A.description: You followed the old route correctly and recovered one of the Ghost Ship's forgotten field caches.

d_crates.description: The hold is yours. Unsealed supply crates can be carried out now. Behind them, a black reinforcement door carries the Captain's personal seal and hums with a denser chakra signature.

d_escape.description: You shoulder a supply crate and head for the rail. The Deck Warden reforms in the exit path, chakra hook already in hand.

b_escape.description: The Deck Warden bars the exit one last time.

r_escape.description: The Warden catches you before the rail and drags the crate back into the hold. The exit remains.

d_claim_B1.description: You reach the shore with the crate as the Ghost Ship begins to lift away. The haul is modest, but real.

w_B1.description: You chose the sure supplies and escaped before the ship vanished again.

d_vault.description: The Captain's seal breaks. Cold wind pours from a room that has no opening to the sky. The First Blade steps out, twin cleavers forming from the gale around his hands.

b_fm.description: The First Blade steps through the broken seal.

r_vault.description: The gale folds the room around you. When the ship releases you, the Captain's seal is whole again. Break it once more.

d_claim_B2.description: The wind dies with the First Blade. The restricted vault stands open, revealing equipment the crew itself was never meant to touch.

w_B2.description: You broke the Captain's private seal and claimed what the ship had guarded from its own crew.

d_king.description: At the command dais stands the Captain, almost solid beneath the pale glow of the core-link seals. He studies you as if no time has passed at all. 'You made it farther than most.'

b_king.description: The Captain steps down from the command dais.

r_king.description: The Captain ends the duel and the helm flashes white. A moment later you are back at the approach, the challenge still waiting.

d_claim_C.description: The Captain lowers his weapon. The seal-light around him flickers, but his expression does not. 'Then take what you came for. You earned passage this far.'

w_C.description: You crossed the Ghost Ship from rail to helm and took your reward from the Captain himself.

d_kingoath.description: The Captain turns before you reach the dais. The Oathkeeper's mark is already burning across the floor. 'Oathbound.' White crystal rises around his brow as the ship's seal network wakes in answer. 'Then face what the ship remembers best.'

b_kingE.description: The White Crown forms. The Crowned Captain steps down as every seal on the helm answers him.

r_king_oath.description: The Crowned Captain breaks your guard and the helm flashes white. The oath remains recorded. When you return to the dais, he is waiting at full synchronization.

d_claim_Co.description: The White Crown fractures into pale light as the Captain drops to one knee. He laughs once, breathless. 'Oath kept.' The command stores unlock behind him.

w_Co.description: You honored the ship's challenge and defeated the Captain at full synchronization. The Ghost Ship yields its richest stores before it fades.

jutsuRetheme.name: Knotted Lash
jutsuRetheme.description: A seal-wrapped line snaps with the weight of a mooring chain.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user snaps a seal-wrapped line across %target, the weighted knots cracking like a mooring chain.

jutsuRetheme.name: Shard Volley
jutsuRetheme.description: A burst of Skyglass splinters scatters from a release seal.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user breaks a release seal and drives a spray of pale Skyglass shards into %target.

jutsuRetheme.name: Chakra Hook
jutsuRetheme.description: A chakra-fed grappling hook bites and hauls.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user throws a chakra-fed hook into %target and yanks hard, tearing them off balance.

jutsuRetheme.name: Wakeblade
jutsuRetheme.description: A cutting arc shaped from compressed chakra and wind.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user sweeps a crescent of compressed chakra through %target, the wake biting a heartbeat after the strike.

jutsuRetheme.name: Binding Chain
jutsuRetheme.description: A weighted chakra chain whips across the deck.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user casts a weighted chakra chain around %target and snaps it tight.

jutsuRetheme.name: Rigging Snare
jutsuRetheme.description: Seal-threaded rigging lashes out and pins the target.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user sends seal-threaded rigging around %target's legs, cinching them to the deck.

jutsuRetheme.name: Flash Seal
jutsuRetheme.description: A primed seal bursts with blinding chakra.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user triggers a flash seal in %target's face, flooding their sight with white chakra.

jutsuRetheme.name: Strangling Weed
jutsuRetheme.description: Chakra-fed growth tightens around the target and drains their strength.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user drives chakra through the wet growth around %target, tightening it across throat and chest.

jutsuRetheme.name: Hull-Crush Coil
jutsuRetheme.description: Timber, cable, and seal-thread constrict as one.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user folds broken timber and cable around %target and crushes inward.

jutsuRetheme.name: Seal Harpoon
jutsuRetheme.description: A barbed spear carries a binding seal into the wound.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user drives a seal-marked harpoon into %target, the tag flaring as the shaft lands.

jutsuRetheme.name: Measured Verdict
jutsuRetheme.description: A precise cut brands the target for follow-up attacks.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user marks %target with a precise cut, leaving a pale judgement sigil for every strike that follows.

jutsuRetheme.name: White-Fire Riposte
jutsuRetheme.description: A counterstroke ignites with the ship's white command flame.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user answers %target's pressure with a white-fire riposte that lands before the stance breaks.

jutsuRetheme.name: Chart-Pin Barrage
jutsuRetheme.description: Iron map pins become a precise projectile storm.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user flicks a fan of iron chart-pins toward %target, each one guided by a thin line of chakra.

jutsuRetheme.name: Redrawn Course
jutsuRetheme.description: A Wayfinder seal alters the target's timing and route.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user strikes %target with a course seal, forcing their next technique onto a longer path.

jutsuRetheme.name: Counterweight Maul
jutsuRetheme.description: A heavy maul driven by stored momentum.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user swings the counterweight maul into %target, stored force releasing at the moment of impact.

jutsuRetheme.name: Crossed Out
jutsuRetheme.description: A ledger seal marks the target's tools and techniques as forfeit.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user strikes a line through %target's seal-mark, cutting access to their techniques.

jutsuRetheme.name: Buried Grasp
jutsuRetheme.description: Packed sand forms a hand around the target's footing.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user raises a hand of packed sand around %target's ankles and locks them in place.

jutsuRetheme.name: Sand Choke
jutsuRetheme.description: A tightening column of sand crushes breath and chakra.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user closes a spinning column of sand around %target, draining breath, chakra, and strength.

jutsuRetheme.name: Burial Tide
jutsuRetheme.description: Sand and surf fold over the target in one heavy surge.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user folds wet sand and surf over %target in a crushing burial wave.

jutsuRetheme.name: Shorebreak
jutsuRetheme.description: A wall of wet sand and shell fragments breaks forward.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user drives a breaking wall of wet sand and shell fragments through %target.

jutsuRetheme.name: Tidal Grave
jutsuRetheme.description: A crushing tide collapses into a seal-shaped hollow.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user drops a heavy tide over %target and seals the collapsing water around them.

jutsuRetheme.name: Undertow Chain
jutsuRetheme.description: A dragging chain steals footing like a sudden undertow.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user whips an undertow chain beneath %target's stance and tears their footing away.

jutsuRetheme.name: Vault Breaker
jutsuRetheme.description: A focused strike designed to punch through reinforced seals and barriers.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user drives a vault-breaking strike through %target, ignoring the defenses in its path.

jutsuRetheme.name: Dead Reckoning
jutsuRetheme.description: A calculated finishing line with no wasted motion.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user fixes %target's position, commits to the line, and delivers Dead Reckoning without hesitation.

jutsuRetheme.name: Gale Cleaver
jutsuRetheme.description: Twin cleavers ride a compressed gale.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user rides a compressed gale into %target, twin cleavers arriving on the wind's edge.

jutsuRetheme.name: Thunderhead Brand
jutsuRetheme.description: A storm seal marks the target for heavier follow-up damage.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user brands %target with a thunderhead seal, drawing every following strike toward the mark.

jutsuRetheme.name: Depth Seal
jutsuRetheme.description: A suppression seal drags the target's strength, defenses, and recovery downward.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user drives a depth seal into %target, suppressing their power, opening their guard, and choking recovery.

jutsuRetheme.name: Wreck Mirage
jutsuRetheme.description: The ship's stored battle memories fracture into a battlefield-wide illusion.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user releases a wreck mirage around %target, broken hulls and false impacts striking from every direction.

jutsuRetheme.name: Final Fathom
jutsuRetheme.description: The Crowned Captain binds the target to the ship's deepest command seal.
jutsuRetheme.battleDescription: %user locks %target beneath the Final Fathom, binding body and chakra under the ship's command.

XhilCv1Hq4eNt-Wddok-m.description: A concentrated restorative sealed for long-duration chakra operations aboard the Ghost Ship. One dose restores the body as quickly as it drains the bottle.
XhilCv1Hq4eNt-Wddok-m.battleDescription: %user drains the Stillwater Tonic in one measure.

ayiRmSjWs05lMPyL3G-1d.name: Fragment of the White Crown
ayiRmSjWs05lMPyL3G-1d.description: A shard of the White Crown, threaded with dormant command seals. Five fragments resonate as if remembering a single shape.
ayiRmSjWs05lMPyL3G-1d.battleDescription: The fragment glimmers with pale seal-light.

yTS9TSpr_QLnh_3zmEpGg.name: The White Crown
yTS9TSpr_QLnh_3zmEpGg.description: Five fragments restored into the command crown once worn by the Captain. Its sealwork still answers the Ghost Ship's distant core.
yTS9TSpr_QLnh_3zmEpGg.battleDescription: The White Crown kindles with pale seal-light upon %user's brow.

legacyCleanup.name: Ghostly Sovereign's Diadem
legacyCleanup.action: Remove from Crowned Captain AI attachments. Do not repurpose it as the White Crown and do not expose it as loot. Leave the standalone hidden legacy item record otherwise untouched unless separately approved.

questRewardCorrection.reason: White Crown Fragment is exclusively a 20% Crowned Captain AI drop; remove the existing 10% quest-completion roll from both Gather and Hunt.
